events.ECHOING_WELL.title: 收音井
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.description:
你往井里扔了一块石头。

井下先传来拔剑的声音。过了一会儿，才是落水声。

两只小水母把触须贴在井沿。旁边的小瓶轻轻一震，像在等你再说一句。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.RECOR: 移除[blue]1[/blue]张非X费攻击或技能牌。获得[gold]瓶中回声[/gold]。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.LOCKE: 没有可封存的牌，或已获得瓶中回声。
events.ECHOING_WELL.selectionPrompt: 移除一张非X费攻击或技能牌，封存它的回声。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.RECORDED.description:
牌没入井口，却没有落水。井下传来了你下一次使出它的声音。

你把声音装进瓶子。塞子刚扣好，瓶里轻轻响了[gold]三下[/gold]。

再看手中，原来的牌已经不见了。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.LEAVE.description:
你没有碰那只瓶子。

走出几步，身后也响起了脚步声。

比你慢了一拍。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.ABORTED.description:
你收回了手。

井里也传来一声犹豫的轻响。两只水母继续等着。
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.COINS.description:
你捡起井沿上的几枚[gold]金币[/gold]。

井里传来了一声清脆的道谢。

你还没来得及开口。

relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.title: 瓶中回声
relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.description: 接下来的[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗，首回合将封存牌的复制品加入手牌。它耗能为[blue]0[/blue]，具有[gold]消耗[/gold]和[gold]虚无[/gold]。
relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.flavor: 有些招式，井比你记得更牢。

events.ECHOING_WELL.title: Echoing Well
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.description:
You drop a stone down the well.

First comes the sound of a sword being drawn. The splash arrives some time later.

Two tiny jellyfish press their feelers against the rim. A little bottle trembles beside them, waiting for you to say something else.
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.RECOR: Remove [blue]1[/blue] non-X-cost Attack or Skill. Obtain [gold]Bottled Echo[/gold].
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.LOCKE: No eligible card, or you already own Bottled Echo.
events.ECHOING_WELL.selectionPrompt: Remove a non-X-cost Attack or Skill to bottle its echo.
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.RECORDED.description:
The card vanishes into the well without a splash. From below comes the sound of the next time you would have used it.

You catch the sound in the bottle. As the cork settles, it taps [gold]three times[/gold].

The original card is gone.
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.LEAVE.description:
You leave the bottle alone.

A few steps later, footsteps follow behind you.

One beat late.
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.ABORTED.description:
You pull your hand back.

A small, hesitant sound rises from the well. The jellyfish keep waiting.
events.ECHOING_WELL.pages.COINS.description:
You collect a few [gold]coins[/gold] from the rim.

A clear voice thanks the well.

You had not spoken yet.

relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.title: Bottled Echo
relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.description: For the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, add a copy of the stored card to your hand on turn 1. It costs [blue]0[/blue] and has [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
relics.BOTTLED_ECHO.flavor: Some moves, the well remembers better than you do.
